mechanism: Build at least four self-contained style modules. Each module must introduce one original character, one material or line-behavior rule, and one short action that could not be explained by color grading alone. Connect modules with one repeated composition slot, emblem position or motion direction. In the final beat, bring the intact characters into one neutral shared stage while preserving each character's original medium, edge behavior and surface response. The reusable mechanism is medium-specific proof, matched modular handoff and heterogeneous ensemble convergence—not the source characters, named styles, exact order, cards, text, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Give every module one different original character and one medium-specific material rule.
invariants.purpose: Separates genuine style construction from palette swapping.
invariants.ablation_failure: The same render with filters cannot prove cross-medium design.

invariants.rule: Include one short action that visibly demonstrates each medium's behavior.
invariants.ablation_failure: Static portraits provide weak transfer evidence.

invariants.rule: Repeat one composition slot, emblem position or motion direction across modules.
invariants.purpose: Creates continuity despite radical surface changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unmatched cards read as unrelated samples.

invariants.rule: Keep each outgoing character readable until the next module's anchor arrives.
invariants.purpose: Makes transitions attributable rather than abrupt.

invariants.rule: Converge intact heterogeneous characters on one neutral stage without restyling them uniformly.
invariants.purpose: Proves co-presence and completes the system.
invariants.ablation_failure: A final common filter erases the central difference.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source warriors and representative character designs
source clay, painted, ink, storybook and comic executions in their exact order
source captions, style labels, logos and typography
source module layouts, transitions and final ensemble staging
source MiniMax H3 creator identity, prompt thread and timing
